in_short: This page is kept out of search on purpose, and that is right. Nothing changed for ranking or in the text.
It now tells you how often owners ask for a new password, which is the first sign that logging in is giving trouble.
6 changes are on the branch: 3 technical, 3 tracking.

scorecard.before: Yes: noindex, not in the sitemap

scorecard.after: Same tag and consent settings as the homepage

scorecard.metric: Layout shift while loading, lab test

needs_you_intro: Nothing on this page needs you. One note so it does not surprise you later.

needs_you.title: A request for an unknown email still counts as a request
needs_you.detail: Supabase answers "sent" whether or not the address has an account, so that nobody can use this form to find out who is registered. The page shows "Check your email for the reset link" either way, and `password_reset_requested` fires either way. That is the safe behaviour. It means the count is of requests, not of emails actually sent.

changes_intro: Everything below is committed on `claude/practical-keller-adcqrc`. The page looks the same.

changes.title: Google Analytics added
changes.why: The tag is the homepage's, with the same consent defaults and the same stored choice. It sends the page address without anything that follows a #.
changes.after: gtag.js G-1235J90MCS, consent default denied, reads rihla_consent

changes.title: `password_reset_requested` and `password_reset_request_failed`
changes.why: The first fires when Supabase accepts the request, the second when it refuses, for example after too many requests in a row. Neither carries the email address.

changes.title: `cta_click` on 5 links, and the cookie notice
changes.why: The cookie notice comes with `site.js`, which this page now loads.

changes.title: Icons and language, as on the homepage
changes.why: Added the `favicon.ico` fallback, the iPhone icon and `theme-color`, and set `lang="en-US"`.

changes.title: Same font request as the homepage
changes.why: The page now sends the identical request, so a visitor arriving from the homepage already has it cached.

changes.title: Taller tap areas
changes.why: "Back to Rihla" in the top bar was 18 px tall and the footer links 17 px. They are now 42 px and 29 px to tap. Nothing moved.

left_alone: **noindex, nofollow.** Correct, and the page is not in the sitemap.
**Title, description and text.** Clear as they are.
**Share tags and structured data.** Left out on purpose.
**The reset code.** Untouched apart from the Analytics lines. The link in the email still leads to the reset page.
verify_intro: Do these once the branch is published.
verify: Ask for a reset link for an account you own. The email should arrive as before.
In GA4, open Reports, then Realtime, after accepting cookies. `password_reset_requested` should appear.

files.change: Google tag, two events, click names, icons, fonts, tap areas

method: Audited from the repository and rendered in headless Chrome on a local copy of the site. 26 common checks and 5 page checks pass.
The checks run against a stand-in for Supabase's library. No email was sent from your Supabase project.
The live site and the public CDN are unreachable from the audit sandbox, so nothing here was checked in production.
